# Running the challenge

## Linux

    chmod +x complex_calibration
    ./complex_calibration

## Other

Run via a browser interface using Dockers

```
    cd <source>/challenges/rev/RUBIK
    docker compose --build up 
```

## Stuck seeing the structure?

A **diagnostic view** can be unlocked as a hint. It runs in your browser (works on
any OS, no install) and is also downloadable to run locally. It helps you *see* the
panel; it does not solve it for you.
